capabilities: check translated note pairs against a CSV glossary
report missing approved and forbidden terms per prose block
open source or target note at a finding
run batch checks over declared note pairs in a folder (Pro)
save and load client glossary profiles (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a translation tool; it does not translate or edit text, it only reports glossary findings for review.
extras: Freemium: single-pair checks are free; folder checks and glossary profiles require Pro unlocked via GitHub Sponsors. After minor or major updates the plugin opens a What's new tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be disabled in settings). README states mobile devices and several desktop interactions were not tested.
problem: Obsidian has no way to verify that translated notes follow an approved terminology list or avoid forbidden terms.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once)

summary: Glossary checker that audits translated source/target note pairs for missing approved and forbidden terms from a loaded CSV glossary.
